description: Real-repo corpus (issue #21 part 2): public repos using the LaunchDarkly server SDK, pinned to a full commit SHA. Fields per repo: name, url (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>), sha (40 hex), language, license (SPDX, informational), note, timeout (seconds for everything about the repo), depth (git fetch --depth). Verified 2026-11-26 with the GitHub API and a shallow clone plus grep. See scripts/corpus/README.md.
